observations.reason: Three packaged rc29 desktops ran concurrently on one host with three distinct self-provisioned Nostr identities, but none reached an authenticated room join. Sarah voice requires an active alpha-cohort row written only by the owner-run admit-sarah-voice-npub script, and room access requires NIP-29 kind-9000 admission signed by the group admin key. Both are owner-only and out of band, so no participant reached POST /api/sarah/livekit/room/join.
No member joined the room, so no server-issued floor lease exists. POST /api/sarah/livekit/room/floor/member is unreachable until admission clears.
Blocked behind floor acquisition: no lease was ever issued, so no transfer between two distinct holders could be attempted.
Moderator stop requires a NIP-29 group admin identity holding a live presence lease. No identity was admitted to the group, so the moderator floor route was never exercised.
Requires at least two admitted members in one live room. Admission never cleared, so the non-holder attempt was never made.

Not reachable, and additionally not satisfiable with the expected code on this backend: removeSarahLiveKitRoomMember, the only producer of member_removed, has no non-test caller. Production resolveMember returns undefined for a removed member, which the routes map to 403 room_membership_required.
Nonce replay refusal (nonce_replayed, 409) is implemented on both floor routes, but it requires a previously accepted grant. No grant was ever issued, so no nonce could be replayed.
Sarah was never summoned into a community room, so no shared answer was published and no participant could confirm audible output.

Same implementation gap as removed_member_refused: membership_changed is produced only by removeSarahLiveKitRoomMember, which no production path calls. A membership change instead invalidates the binding and yields 403 room_membership_required.

note: This receipt preserves what one operator observed for one Sarah LiveKit release-gate row against the named binding. It is not a release-gate admission: an outcome of observed_pass means the observations were preserved, not that the row is green.
